images.title: M, S and the plus sign: which test do they pass
images.purpose: Show the worked example: the letter M passes only the fold test, the letter S passes only the turn test, and the plus sign passes both.
images.composition: Three cards in a row, one sign on each with its dashed lines or its curved turn arrow, and a caption under each.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Three cards in one row. Each card is a rounded rectangle 380 wide and 440 tall with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and a white fill, at x 80 to 460, 538 to 918 and 996 to 1376, all at y 130 to 570. CARD 1: the capital letter M in plain sans-serif, teal #0072B2, 280 px tall, centred, with one dashed vertical line in grey #6B7280 (5 px dashes) down its exact middle at x 270, from y 150 to y 550. CARD 2: the capital letter S in plain sans-serif, teal #0072B2, 280 px tall, centred, with no dashed line; around it one curved arrow in reddish purple #CC79A7 going half way round, 8 px thick, with the text 1/2 turn (36 px, dark #1F2937) next to it at the top right of the card. CARD 3: a plus sign, teal #0072B2, two bars each 260 px long and 60 px thick crossing at the exact middle of the card, with one dashed vertical line and one dashed horizontal line in grey #6B7280 through the middle, and one curved arrow in reddish purple #CC79A7 going a quarter of the way round with the text 1/4 turn (36 px, dark) next to it at the top right of the card. Under the cards, centred on each card at y 640, a caption in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (40 px): M: reflection only, S: turn only, Plus sign: both. Exactly 3 signs, 3 dashed lines in all (1 on card 1 and 2 on card 3), 2 curved arrows and 3 captions. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a dashed line on the S
images.takeaway: A fold test and a turn test can give different answers, so run both.
images.description: Three cards: the letter M with a dashed vertical line, the letter S with a curved arrow for a 1/2 turn, and a plus sign with dashed lines and a curved arrow for a 1/4 turn.
images.context: Concept image for the teaching concept Reflection Only, Turn Only or Both. It uses the plan's own M, S and plus sign (practice values), not the letters or digits of the book's questions.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student which test each card passes: the dashed line is the fold test and the arrow is the turn test. The slip to watch: thinking that one kind of symmetry brings the other.

image_decisions.why: The three signs with their dashed lines and turn arrows make the worked example visible: one passes the fold test only, one the turn test only, one both.
